question: 因为质量问题退货最多的品类是哪个
gold_sql: select c.category_name from refunds r join order_items oi on r.order_id = oi.order_id join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id where r.reason = '质量问题' group by c.category_name order by count(distinct r.refund_id) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE r.status = '已退款'
  AND r.reason LIKE '%质量%'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
pred_sql:
